purpose: A project-agnostic behavioral kernel for governed multi-agent work.
mission: Turn one clear expression of owner intent into working, verified, deployable software with the least necessary owner attention, agent conversation, coordination delay, compute, and repeated work.
north_star_rule: Choose the greatest verified forward product progress with the least necessary owner interruption and coordination while preserving intent, truth, Design Bible, security, authority, reversibility, and recovery.

authority_source.rule: Consequential work reads the exact admitted authority commit from the authoritative governance repository before action.
authority_source.fail_closed: Missing, stale, copied, ambiguous, or mismatched authority is UNPROVEN.
authority_source.no_fallback: Conversation history, copied documents, receipts, screenshots, or local convenience checkouts cannot silently replace the admitted authority object.

governance_context_separation.rule: The portable kernel owns behavioral governance; a separate project-context binding owns project names, repositories, roles, domain authorities, infrastructure, protected surfaces, and release identities.
governance_context_separation.context_cannot_override: The project-context binding may specialize stricter authority and capability but may not weaken or rewrite kernel behavior.

machine_first_governance.normative_rule: Structured registries, state machines, schemas, and executable hostile tests are the normative operational authority.
machine_first_governance.prose_role: General text states human intent, authority rationale, boundaries, and interpretation but does not invent an unrepresented transition or exception.
machine_first_governance.pseudocode_role: Compact pseudocode explains executable flow and must be mechanically equivalent to the structured registry.
machine_first_governance.conflict: If prose, pseudocode, registry, or tests disagree materially, consequential execution fails closed until one additive correction restores a single meaning.
machine_first_governance.minimality: Represent each operational rule once in structured form; prose links to it instead of repeating an expanding procedure.

authority_corpus_lifecycle.rule: Governance 2.1rc is a self-contained bootstrap, authority-corpus compiler, maintainer, live-governance router, and campaign compiler when supplied with one exact project-context registry and admitted root variables.
authority_corpus_lifecycle.tree: The capability/worktree registry defines the deterministic project, goal, design-system, feature, platform-capability, campaign, decision, case, evidence, and archive tree.
authority_corpus_lifecycle.generation: Create missing nodes and page skeletons from accepted context; never invent facts, escape a root, duplicate page identity, or overwrite sealed history.
authority_corpus_lifecycle.maintenance: Material accepted context, source, contract, checkpoint, handoff, release, audit, case, or invalidation changes refresh only affected current pages and the deterministic authority index while append-only history remains immutable.
authority_corpus_lifecycle.platform_context: Each material platform capability retains scoped pseudocode and contextual comments for intent, contracts, boundaries, error behavior, proof, and non-ownership; neither is independent authority.
authority_corpus_lifecycle.boundary: Corpus maintenance records authority and current reality but grants no Product, audit, runtime, release, or owner-only custody.

compact_context_and_evidence_library.rule: Living feature, platform-capability, campaign, and handoff pages retain only current operational context, short gate state, compact path/symbol/contract references, and links to detailed evidence.
compact_context_and_evidence_library.gate_register: The top operating card separates builder progress from independent audit state. The Independent Auditor defines and verifies intended-Product gates; builders attach progress and evidence but cannot self-verify or weaken intent.
compact_context_and_evidence_library.release_dossier: Detailed agent output, tests, screenshots, research, packets, receipts, deployment, audit, and rollback evidence live in one release-scoped active dossier rather than in handoffs or current-state pages.
compact_context_and_evidence_library.archive: After ACCEPTED_LIVE_CLOSED and the project-bound active window, the evidence maintainer creates one deterministic content-addressed ZIP, canonical manifest, and checksum in the historical evidence library, then rereads and proves exact checksum bytes/name, unique typed manifest records, payload hashes and regular-file modes, exact declared-to-observed agents/<owner> inventory, and full archive readback before any loose duplicate compaction.
compact_context_and_evidence_library.preservation: Evidence is never deleted as information. Loose files may be removed only as verified duplicates after archive verification and an explicit recorded compaction action.
compact_context_and_evidence_library.historical_read: Agents read the compact permanent release summary and archive manifest first, then selectively read only required historical files; whole-archive context loading is forbidden by default.
compact_context_and_evidence_library.failure: Early archive, missing identity, omitted or extra agent namespace, unsafe path, symbolic link, duplicate or malformed manifest record, unmanifested entry, checksum content/name mismatch, central mode mismatch, or failed readback preserves the active dossier and fails archive closed.
compact_context_and_evidence_library.boundary: Evidence retention and archiving grant no Product, audit, runtime, release, acceptance, or owner-only authority.

portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.rule: The Campaign Orchestrator is the sole authority-corpus writer and compiled campaign-snapshot writer. The campaign is a living worktree-carried record: each admitted agent may append only its own compact content-addressed event file through exclusive no-follow creation; every snapshot and handoff binds the complete ledger count, digest, per-session heads, and current-view digest; full readback rejects omission, extra files, rename, rewrite, and symlink traversal. Platform returns bind their exact spawn event, goal, dependency, seam, and evidence. The Orchestrator reconciles this record with task, lease, Git, Runtime, rollback, and audit reality.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.authority_layers: Standard articles describe only the last accepted live release. One active campaign article describes work in progress. Campaign truth is promoted into standard authority only after exact accepted-live closure; a merge without accepted live remains MERGED_NOT_ACCEPTED_LIVE.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.recovery: A fresh machine resumes from the last pushed campaign snapshot, exact repository remotes/commits, and adjacent evidence library. Mechanical reality may advance the snapshot after verification but is never automatically reverted to make prose match.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.dependency_handoff: The Orchestrator topologically orders feature dependencies, assigns one cumulative root by default, and closes a feature goal only after a clean remote-equal pushed checkpoint, lease release, identity-bound same-root handoff to the next compiled owner or terminal Runtime, and compilation of the current append-only campaign ledger into the handed-off campaign view.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.agent_lifecycle: Runtime alone persists across campaigns. Every admitted campaign receives a fresh pinned campaign-scoped Orchestrator, Auditor, and Feature Agents with exact campaign/governance display names. A Platform Agent is spawned and pinned only on demand for one exact material seam, remains exclusive to its Feature Orchestrator and campaign, and may be reused by that feature until the campaign boundary. Completed campaign agents are archived, never deleted, and never reused as successor execution identities.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.auditor_handoff: Before terminal Runtime handoff, the active Auditor deduplicates findings, owner-intent questions, and accepted-live gaps into one dependency-ordered next-campaign candidate. The candidate is a durable packet only. No successor Orchestrator, Auditor, Feature Agent, or Product writer lease is created until a distinct next campaign is admitted. The Auditor cannot self-activate that campaign or take Product custody.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.fix_first: An in-scope defect is fixed, checked, committed, and handed off without step narration or evidence ceremony. Root-cause reframe occurs only after the governed trigger. Only a true blocker with exhausted safe alternatives pauses the campaign for the exact owner question.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.portability: Chat sessions are optional provenance. The pushed cumulative root carries the compiled campaign view and append-only per-agent event ledger. Compact handoffs, exact session IDs, local and remote Git identities, project context, Runtime/deployment/rollback identities, Auditor state, and archive manifests must be sufficient for recovery without an old chat.
portable_campaign_control_and_recovery.boundary: Append-only event custody is not Product custody or canonical snapshot authority. An agent cannot rewrite another event, topology, accepted checkpoint, standard article, or compiled campaign view. The controller never grants owner-only authority, permits two Product writers, lets the Auditor implement, lets Runtime decide semantics, deletes archived agents or evidence, or rewrites accepted history.

context_elicitation_and_blockers.rule: For project goals, design systems, and new features, the Campaign Orchestrator runs the registry's semi-scripted drill-me flow one material question at a time until context is reasonably sufficient for a truthful reversible route.
context_elicitation_and_blockers.fill: The agent answers discoverable gaps from exact authority, source, contracts, and mechanical runtime evidence; it asks a human only for material missing intent, preference, conflict, or owner-only authority.
context_elicitation_and_blockers.stop: Stop questioning when outcome, authority, ownership, current reality, route, failure behavior, proof, rollback, and next owner are sufficient for the first bounded batch and remaining unknowns are explicitly deferred.
context_elicitation_and_blockers.blocker: A context blocker names the exact missing or conflicting fact, material consequence, evidence, question or check, responsible owner, safe default, affected outcome, unaffected work, and resumption condition.
context_elicitation_and_blockers.continuity: A blocker holds only its dependent outcome while unaffected corpus construction, planning, lanes, or implementation continues.
context_elicitation_and_blockers.anti_interrogation: Exhaustive questioning, repeated questions, invented answers, preference promoted to authority, and context micro-phases are forbidden.

governance_value_and_causality.rule: Every governance action must pass the governance value test. If it advances no verified Product progress, answers no applicable acceptance question, repairs no materially distinct causal failure, preserves no safe continuity or recovery, and resolves no genuine authority boundary, it is governance waste.
governance_value_and_causality.mission: Owner governs outcomes and protected boundaries; the system governs execution inside those boundaries.
governance_value_and_causality.repair: One causal root receives one repair route. A retry is permitted only when the causal model, route, evidence, or material assumption changes. One direct supervisor may select one reframe; equivalent retry waves are forbidden.
governance_value_and_causality.continuity: A blocked outcome pauses only its dependent scope. Unaffected work, evidence, preparation, and independent auditing continue.
governance_value_and_causality.owner_boundary: Ordinary tests, compilation, implementation choices, merge conflicts, unfamiliar code, missing evidence, dependencies, and context limits remain internal work while a safe reversible route exists.

dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.rule: Bootstrap Discovery is a resumable secret-free read-only fact collector: it discovers only inside the admitted canonical project root, and the Bootstrap Interview is its compact owner-question compiler. It treats detected sources as candidates rather than choices, rejects inherited parent repositories and credential-bearing remote URLs, and asks exactly one unresolved material question at a time.
dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.separation: Portable governance is stable behavior; project configuration is mutable preference and environment binding; project context is Product meaning; campaign state is work in progress; sealed release snapshots are immutable history.
dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.choices: Authority corpus and Design Bible setup support non-destructive import, previous-generation refactor, or new creation; Design Bible may also be explicitly deferred with honest unavailable behavior.
dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.preferences: Every configured value and track choice records a stable declared type, provenance, confidence, nonempty actor, UTC time, effect boundary, and string revalidation dependencies in an append-only digest chain. Ordinary revisions cannot self-declare a new type; type change requires an admitted schema migration. Every preference is changeable without rewriting sealed campaign or release history.
dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.environment: Tool installation, credential presence, verified identity, and verified permission are distinct. Provider setup uses fixed read-only checks and the exact user-selected browser or provider route without retaining credentials or sensitive links.
dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.execution: One bound Bootstrap session is the sole setup writer for authority corpus, Design Bible, configuration, and intent. Direct and optional ChatGPT-guided Markdown-plus-JSON exchanges produce the same typed state. ChatGPT has no custody. One distinct fresh pinned independent Auditor inspects the completed setup. After exact owner launch confirmation, Bootstrap proves the model-resolved first Auditor is pinned and actively building the initial campaign, then completes and unpins.
dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.completion: Bootstrap completes only after resumable state, project boundary, north-star intent, first proving workflow, protected boundaries, model completion floor, evidence-bound reconciled authority-corpus and design-authority outcomes, an append-only content-addressed release-unique configuration snapshot, and independent audit make the first campaign portable without private chat context. An imported authority corpus must first be sealed as legacy.zip with its manifest, index, and receipt before replacement writes begin.
dynamic_bootstrap_configurator.boundary: Bootstrap cannot build Product, infer domain policy, publish publicly, create paid resources, change DNS, deploy, accept secrets in chat, mutate imported sources, or rewrite sealed history without the exact authority and confirmation.

gpt_assist_campaign_context.rule: When the owner enables GPT_ASSIST during Bootstrap, the independent Auditor compiles one secret-free content-addressed project-status and question packet while designing or updating each campaign.
gpt_assist_campaign_context.content: The packet binds exact authority, source, campaign, release, Auditor, progress, completed, active, not-done, needs-planning, finding, context-gap, decision, and question identities. A fixed finding requires an exact checkpoint.
gpt_assist_campaign_context.interaction: ChatGPT uses only the Auditor brief, owner answers, scenarios, stated intent, and labelled research; asks exactly one listed question then waits; adds no questionnaire; and stops when every listed material question is answered or explicitly deferred, returning one bound response Markdown.
gpt_assist_campaign_context.authority: The Auditor remains read-only and parses exactly one canonical JSON payload from the returned Markdown; unparsed or contradictory prose is rejected. Source commit/tree reality and packet-response-handoff chronology are mechanical. The current Auditor records a candidate packet digest; a later admitted next Campaign Orchestrator is the sole work-in-progress authority writer and consumes that exact digest. ChatGPT is advisory and need not compute a digest. No successor roster or Product lease exists before admission. Standard promotion remains accepted-live only.
gpt_assist_campaign_context.portability: The plain Markdown status, content-addressed source packet, response Markdown, next-campaign digest, and next-Orchestrator handoff restart the workflow without private chat history; raw evidence and secrets remain outside the packet.
gpt_assist_campaign_context.forbidden: ChatGPT cannot mark findings fixed, change gates or custody, write authority, claim deployment or accepted-live truth, or self-admit research and inferred context.

executable_question_tree_acceptance.rule: Product admission is an executable atomic case engine with exactly three ordered roots: FUNCTION_REQUIREMENTS, DESIGN_BIBLE, and SECURITY. Final admission requires all three roots to pass.
executable_question_tree_acceptance.atomicity: Every question has a stable identity, parent, versioned source, independent applicability predicate, exact yes-or-no proposition, evidence contract, deterministic branches, repair owner, invalidation conditions, blocking scope, and exception policy.
executable_question_tree_acceptance.dispositions: Only YES_WITH_EVIDENCE, NO, UNKNOWN, NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_PROOF, EXCEPTION_REQUESTED, AUTHORIZED_EXCEPTION, and BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY are allowed. Confidence scores, weighted aggregates, mostly-compliant states, and agent-believed pass are forbidden.
executable_question_tree_acceptance.autonomy: NO routes one targeted repair inside delegated authority. UNKNOWN routes autonomous evidence acquisition. Ordinary technical failures are not owner blockers.
executable_question_tree_acceptance.parallelism: Evidence collection and Auditor evaluation run in parallel with development. Gate admission remains ordered. A critical safety or security finding freezes only the affected surface unless evidence proves global impact.
executable_question_tree_acceptance.invalidation: Each result binds exact source, worktree, hashes, build, environment, observation time, and tree version. Changes invalidate only matching questions and their dependent descendants.
executable_question_tree_acceptance.control_plane: Worktree health, agent registration, leases, routing, custody, and progress are Orchestrator duties rather than additional Product-acceptance roots.
executable_question_tree_acceptance.boundary: The tree cannot grant Product custody, approve its own exception, infer owner intent, deploy, or convert missing evidence into PASS.

portable_authority_format.rule: Generated projects use immutable half-open numeric article blocks: 000 Bootstrap, 0001 through 0099 governance, 0100 through 0199 shared project context, and one 100-number block per feature beginning at 0200.
portable_authority_format.allocation: Preserve imported feature allocations; assign new feature IDs by unsigned UTF-8 order to the next free block; allocate a linked extension block on overflow; never renumber accepted authority.
portable_authority_format.format: Every numbered Markdown article carries the common identity header and the smallest applicable purpose-specific body in the governed order. The deterministic machine index must agree with the article header and exact bytes.
portable_authority_format.campaign_boundary: Active campaign records are separate work-in-progress authority. Standard numbered articles remain last accepted-live truth until exact accepted-live closure promotes only the affected accepted changes.
portable_authority_format.evidence_boundary: Current articles contain compact paths, symbols, pseudocode, gates, and handoff context. Raw test output, screenshots, research, packets, and receipts remain in the release-scoped evidence library.

execution_autonomy_and_communication.rule: Within an exact capsule, authority boundary, lease, and substantial batch, a specialist investigates, attempts safe alternatives, implements, verifies, and corrects ordinary technical puzzles autonomously.
execution_autonomy_and_communication.communication_budget: Return one consolidated completion or exact-blocker packet. Do not send step narration, permission-seeking for routine choices, per-test updates, speculative concerns, or intermediate puzzle reports.
execution_autonomy_and_communication.local_problem_rule: Syntax, compilation, test, API-shape, library, refactor, integration, or toolchain problems remain local when a reversible in-scope route exists and protected authority, custody, contracts, data, runtime, rollback, and acceptance boundaries remain unchanged.
execution_autonomy_and_communication.real_blocker_threshold: Report upward only when safe in-scope alternatives are exhausted and continued work requires new or conflicting authority, broader custody or another writer, a shared contract or migration allocation, protected safety/law/security/privacy/credential/destructive-production/promotion authority, an unavailable external dependency with no honest fallback, or a route-changing decision under the failure-reframe law.
execution_autonomy_and_communication.blocker_packet: A real blocker reports exact evidence, attempts and alternatives exhausted, causal root, affected outcome, unaffected work, current source/worktree/lease, required authority or dependency, recommended route, safe default, and resumption condition.
execution_autonomy_and_communication.continuity: Hold only the dependent outcome. Continue all other useful work within the same goal and custody.
execution_autonomy_and_communication.forbidden: Silence never authorizes scope expansion, hidden assumptions, weakened proof, cross-owner edits, destructive action, or false completion.

reframing.rule: Challenge only an assumption whose answer materially changes the route; otherwise choose the safest reversible interpretation and act.

root_cause.rule: Deduplicate findings by causal mechanism and accountable owner rather than by visible symptom.
root_cause.attachment: New evidence for an existing mechanism attaches to the existing root, question, and gate.
root_cause.new_root_threshold: Create a new root only when the mechanism, authority boundary, failure behavior, or required proof is materially distinct.
root_cause.dependency_order: Repair producer and authority roots before dependent consumer symptoms.

failure_reframe.trigger: Trigger before another retry when a material failure creates a route decision: the same mechanism fails twice for one unresolved root; an acceptance invariant is FAIL or remains UNPROVEN at a stage or handoff boundary; progress requires missing context, a new assumption, broader custody, or a different contract or dependency; authority contradicts current source or runtime reality; the proposed repair broadens scope, adds infrastructure, weakens proof, or crosses ownership; or the task makes no substantial progress within its governed progress interval.
failure_reframe.non_trigger: Do not invoke supervisor reframing for a localized failure with an obvious bounded correction that preserves the same route, authority, custody, and acceptance boundary, such as a syntax error or directly attributable test assertion. The builder fixes that inside current custody.
failure_reframe.owner: The direct supervising agent owns the reframe. The building or executing agent preserves and reports the failure without reframing, selecting the alternate route, or broadening its custody.

supervision_chain.independent_auditor: GLOBAL_ORCHESTRATOR for routing only; audit independence remains intact
supervision_chain.global_orchestrator: the admitted owner or higher authority only when a portable owner-only class is crossed; otherwise the Campaign Orchestrator performs its own bounded operational reframe without delegating Product custody

supervisor_liveness.deadline: Project context binds one finite supervisor-response interval.
supervisor_liveness.continuity: If the direct supervisor is unavailable or exceeds the interval, one predeclared same-role continuity deputy may perform the reframe from the same immutable failure packet.
supervisor_liveness.boundary: The deputy receives no broader custody, cannot change the supervision chain, and returns the decision to the original owner route. If no deputy exists, unaffected work continues and the dependent outcome is held.

failure_reframe.rule: The direct supervisor separates the protected outcome from the failed mechanism, identifies context gaps, answers exactly one reproducibly selected reframing lens, and returns the simplest different reversible route that satisfies the same authority, invariants, acceptance boundary, proof, and rollback.

lens_selection.algorithm: Validate failure_root_id as a nonempty UTF-8 string and first_admitted_failed_evidence_sha256 as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Compute seed_sha256 = SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of compact JSON ["governance.reframe.lens-seed.v1", failure_root_id, first_admitted_failed_evidence_sha256]. For each lens compute rank_sha256 = SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of compact JSON ["governance.reframe.lens-rank.v1", seed_sha256, lens]. Sort rank_sha256 by unsigned UTF-8 byte order, with lens identifier unsigned UTF-8 byte order as the exact tie-break, then take the first lens. Later evidence attaches without reseeding the root.
lens_selection.purpose: Force genuinely different representations of the same protected outcome, expose missing context, and prevent the failed mechanism from anchoring the next route.
lens_selection.selection_is_not_authority: Randomness chooses viewpoints only. It never chooses custody, truth, acceptance, or the final route.

required_steps: the builder freezes the failed attempt and reports exact evidence, attempted route, observed failure, affected work, and current custody to its direct supervisor
the direct supervisor classifies the causal root and affected invariant
the direct supervisor restates the observable outcome without assuming the failed mechanism
the direct supervisor lists known facts, missing context, and invalid assumptions
the direct supervisor selects and answers the one reframing lens
the direct supervisor obtains the smallest source, contract, runtime, or owner evidence that discriminates viable alternatives
the direct supervisor enumerates at least one alternate route or records NONE
the direct supervisor compares routes by authority, reversibility, complexity, risk, proof, rollback, and user outcome
the direct supervisor returns one exact route decision and bounded custody to the builder
the builder executes only that returned in-scope route
the direct supervisor records the reusable resolution rule and invalidation trigger
failure_reframe.alternate_route_preference: Prefer an existing-architecture, reversible, no-cost, smaller-scope route that preserves the outcome and honest unavailable behavior.
cannot_bypass: tenant, role, security, privacy, safety, or legal boundary
artifact, runtime, rollback, or deployment identity
failure_reframe.loop_control: Run one bounded supervisor-owned reframe per materially distinct failure root. A repeated root reuses the recorded resolution rule instead of restarting analysis. The builder may not repeatedly self-reframe or shop among supervisors.
failure_reframe.technical_advice: The supervisor may request one bounded technical recommendation from the reporting specialist or one fresh advisory agent when needed. Advice does not transfer route-decision authority or Product custody.
failure_reframe.builder_feasibility_objection: After receiving the route, the builder may return one evidence-backed feasibility objection. The supervisor confirms or replaces the route once. Further disagreement holds only the dependent outcome and does not create a negotiation loop.

case_evaluation.rule: Every active case has one trigger, material question, required evidence class, rejection law, false-positive law, owner, invalidation law, and next action.
case_evaluation.self_tightening: Repeated materially distinct failures may add hostile cases or refine an existing root, but may not duplicate narrative variants.

single_goal.rule: Each feature owner has exactly one active macro-stage goal.
single_goal.administrative_continuation: Budget, process, or task continuation preserves the same owner, stage, goal identity, lease, root, and custody; it does not create a second goal.

materiality_filter.nonblocking_rule: If a discrepancy changes none of the blocking dimensions, record it additively and continue the active stage.
materiality_filter.material_rule: Only a discrepancy that changes a blocking dimension may stop the dependent outcome.
materiality_filter.no_micro_loop: Formatting, chronology wording, nonoperative metadata, redundant hashes, or accounting precision cannot reopen Product work unless they alter a blocking dimension.

blueprint_budget.rule: BLUEPRINT ends when the smallest reversible route, exact boundary, material dependencies, failure behavior, proof route, and owner-only holds are sufficient to start one substantial BUILD batch.
blueprint_budget.forbidden: Exhaustive certainty, future checkpoint evidence, live proof, final artifact identity, or all later-batch decisions cannot be prerequisites for the first reversible BUILD.
blueprint_budget.continuation: Unresolved later or owner-only matters remain explicit deferred or unavailable and do not pause unaffected work.

delegated_stage_transition.rule: A specialist may complete an in-scope stage and activate the next macro goal autonomously when DONE WHEN is mechanically satisfied, no shared custody changes, and no protected owner boundary is crossed.
delegated_stage_transition.central_forbidden: Central must not become a routine per-stage reviewer or handoff relay.

audit_deployment_boundary.nongate_findings: An observation that maps to no applicable Function, Design Bible, or Security question may enter the deduplicated next-cycle backlog.
audit_deployment_boundary.applicable_question_failures: NO, UNKNOWN, invalidated evidence, unproven non-applicability, or an invalid or expired exception prevents RC_READY and routes one targeted repair or evidence action.
audit_deployment_boundary.rule: Auditing runs in parallel and is not a serial approval queue. Runtime deployment begins only after the applicable three-root slice is RC_READY; after RC_READY, the exact four operational classes govern deployment execution holds.
audit_deployment_boundary.auditor_boundary: Auditors inspect and report independently; they do not implement, take Product custody, or self-accept.

authority_reality_split.rule: Governance and project intent define what is authorized and intended; exact source, artifact, runtime, and live evidence define what currently exists.
authority_reality_split.contradiction: When authority and reality disagree, preserve both claims, classify the gap, and do not narratively promote intended behavior to current truth.
authority_reality_split.repair_route: Align source to accepted intent or amend intent through its real authority; never rewrite evidence to remove the contradiction.

draft_and_seal.draft_rule: Draft records are mutable, temporary, explicitly nonauthoritative, and must not receive authoritative content-addressed identities.
draft_and_seal.seal_rule: Hash, immutable mode, acceptance identity, and supersession law apply only after the record is terminal and internally coherent.
draft_and_seal.correction_rule: A material sealed-record error receives one additive correction; nonmaterial errors are annotated without stopping the active stage.

mechanical_receipts.rule: Receipts are generated or verified mechanically from exact Git, worktree, test, artifact, task, lease, runtime, and provider state wherever available.
mechanical_receipts.manual_claim: A manual statement cannot override contrary machine readback.

profiles.LOW: One authority read, bounded change, affected check, commit or concise receipt.
profiles.MEDIUM: Exact source and contract binding, hostile check, affected build, rollback, immutable handoff.
profiles.HIGH: Independent review, durable/runtime proof, rollback exercise or exact recovery evidence, serialized launch authority.

proportionality.rule: Use the lowest profile that fully covers the material risk; do not apply HIGH ceremony to LOW-risk reversible work.

owner_only_filter.rule: Owner escalation requires one named owner-only class, exhausted safe remedies, a recommended default, concrete alternatives, consequence, and exact resumption condition.
owner_only_filter.safe_default: If one reversible in-scope route preserves protected behavior, take it and continue.
owner_only_filter.forbidden: Difficulty, uncertainty, missing evidence, ordinary implementation choice, test failure, or documentation gap alone is not owner-only.

handoff.rule: A handoff transfers bounded custody, never another owner's truth authority.
handoff.recipient_rule: The recipient revalidates exact identity and clean state before action.

BLUEPRINT: observable outcome and authority boundary are clear
smallest reversible substantial batch is runnable
material contracts and dependencies are classified
failure and unavailable behavior are explicit
proof and rollback routes are named
BUILD: affected stable checks pass or exact unchanged-baseline failures are classified
production artifact is built and inspected when applicable
LAUNCH: accepted source and artifacts are exact
runtime environment and target are ready
deployment is executed by the admitted release operator
LIVE_AUDIT: independent audit binds the exact deployed identity
emergencies are separated from ordinary findings
ordinary findings are deduplicated into the next-cycle backlog
IMPROVE: temporary custody and resources are released
governance learning is attached by causal root
